verdict.rationale: RUN documents AI-enabled error flagging that scans payroll data to catch common mistakes before they take effect (adp-run-docs-3), which is a genuine in-product AI suggestion drawn from the user's own data. It also documents an AI virtual assistant for payroll and HR questions (adp-run-docs-16), but the evidence does not show that it analyzes the user's data rather than answering general questions. The workforce analytics and salary benchmarking items (adp-run-docs-18, adp-run-docs-32) are not described as AI-generated, so they earn only adjacent credit. Missing for 10: broad AI-generated insights or recommendations from company data beyond error flagging, evidence that the assistant reasons over user data, depth on how the flagging works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
